hypothesis.intervention: For the narrow supported single-request decode tail, process the one pending result before invoking get_next_batch_to_run, rather than launching another forward first.
hypothesis.mechanism: Actual final token/finish handler drains and retires request before prepare_for_decode allocates the next KV slot or advances recurrent-state bookkeeping.
hypothesis.observable: Same actual token IDs/finish reason/SSE and cleanup; one fewer forward/preparation for max-length C1 cap>=2; no change to ordinary interior overlap.
falsifiers: No exact pending one-token contract at the gate
Drain does not finish through original handler
A next decode allocation/forward still occurs for the same retired identity
KV/GDN release/reuse invariant or TP rank consensus fails

budget.C: len(req.output_ids), after actual prior result handling
budget.Pmin: Guaranteed number of output tokens represented by the exact same-request not-yet-processed result, under no-spec/no-mask admitted contract; 1 in narrow candidate
budget.Pmax: Upper bound alone is insufficient; uncertain 0..K outcomes must fall back
budget.gate: 0 <= C < L, exactly one pending decode result, exact RID+slot+generation identity, all narrow scope contracts true, C+Pmin >= L
forbidden_substitutes: sum of pending query rows or spec draft width (not a lower bound on accepted tokens)
request list position / task order / time proximity (not identity)

implementation_design.seam: event_loop_overlap after ingest/pause check, before get_next_batch_to_run
actions: Read immutable narrow proof facts without device synchronization or planner mutation.
If eligible, consume existing FIFO result once through original process_batch_result (waits copy_done and handles output/finish/cache/state).
Mark previous result consumed; for decode-only narrow seam last_batch=None prevents later double pop. Do not invent or append tokens, set finished_reason, free pools, or clear FutureMap directly.
Call original planner with finished Req still owned by its normal bookkeeping until original filter; no manually deleting rows or undoing a prepared batch.
Preserve original interior overlap and WAR/copy/sample/relay lifetime; all ineligible cases execute original sequence.
implementation_design.scope: Initially one request, one decode result, non-spec, no grammar/mask/cancel/retract/chunk/mixed/beam/DP/PP/disagg/other pending admissions; no hidden-state/logprob auxiliary contract changes.
implementation_design.source_semantics: kv_committed_len is scheduler-side KV accounting, not evidence a device task completed or an output token was committed.
implementation_design.state_contract_status: UNKNOWN for current hybrid 48 GDN +16 FA model. Source permits Mamba result lookahead 0 or1 but that does not prove device/state-cache reuse safety. No live patch.

ownership_obligations: Do not release the request or KV/GDN state based on budget prediction. Original result handling remains sole output/finish/release owner.
Before slot reuse require all pending reads/writes and copy/sampling/relay work for old RID+slot+allocation-generation fenced; slot reuse must not read stale FutureMap payload.
Validate owned KV length and cache insertion at actual consumed-token length, which may be one shorter without overshoot; never rewrite lengths to mimic old extra work.
Mamba/GDN running state, ping-pong snapshots, masks, decode_batch_idx and result snapshots must all refer to the completed forward; require exact target-model boundary/reuse canaries.
TP ranks agree on the drain/next-forward decision and resulting collectives. A device-layer endpoint is not sufficient for lifecycle proof.
